transcript: Said I went to the immersive production of The Great Gatsby at Park Central Hotel. I went on a recommendation from my friend despite knowing absolutely nothing about The Great Gatsby. This production is extremely immersive, with audience members treated like guests at gatsby's party. The actors interact heavily with you, and they often pull groups out of the main room to share other parts of the story. Other times, party guests are enlisted to help set up the room, such as for Daisy Buchanan arrival. This production really dropped you right in. So while I wish I'd been more familiar going in, I think I was somewhat able to piece my way through the main story lines. In any case, I was definitely entertained and really impressed by the intricacy of the production with how heavily the audience is involved. I can't even imagine how this was rehearsed. If immersive theater or the 19 20s are a thing, I would definitely check this out.
